title: Document governance header
description: Single documented Markdown header contract for managed docs under 文档记录. Headers identify documents; they do not replace task_rules.json mapping or task status.

TASK_KEY.description: Local task identifier matching task_rules.json task_key when tracked.

DOC_TYPE.description: Document layer derived from path conventions under 文档记录.

WORKSTREAM.description: Module or workstream label (for example planning, web, server, wasm).

STATUS.description: Document-local governance status. Not the task status from task_rules.json.

EXECUTION_MODEL.description: Actual model or agent route used for this document. Never a hardcoded stale default.

LAST_TRACKED_AT.description: Last local governance refresh timestamp or date.
